title: Arbor’s Innovative Preferred Equity Solution Delivers Simplicity and Continuity
summary: Arbor Realty Trust partnered with Freddie Mac Multifamily to become the first lender to launch a pioneering program that integrates senior loans and private equity under one roof throughout their lifecycles.
